title: Mandarin: Everyday Phrases

sources.name: Original educational wording based on general subject knowledge

description: For beginners: 100 everyday Mandarin phrases in simplified characters, with tone-marked pinyin, English meanings, and examples for greetings, travel, shopping, and asking for help.

cards.back: Nǐ hǎo. Hello.
cards.example: 你好，我叫李明。 Hello, my name is Li Ming.

cards.back: Nín hǎo. Hello (respectful).
cards.example: 老师，您好。 Hello, teacher.

cards.back: Zǎoshang hǎo. Good morning.
cards.example: 大家早上好。 Good morning, everyone.

cards.back: Wǎnshang hǎo. Good evening.
cards.example: 王先生，晚上好。 Good evening, Mr. Wang.

cards.back: Wǎn'ān. Good night.
cards.example: 妈妈，晚安。 Good night, Mom.

cards.back: Zàijiàn. Goodbye.
cards.example: 明天见，再见。 See you tomorrow; goodbye.

cards.back: Míngtiān jiàn. See you tomorrow.
cards.example: 好，明天见。 Okay, see you tomorrow.

cards.back: Huítóu jiàn. See you later.
cards.example: 我先走了，回头见。 I'm leaving now; see you later.

cards.back: Xièxie. Thank you.
cards.example: 谢谢你的帮助。 Thank you for your help.

cards.back: Fēicháng gǎnxiè. Thank you very much.
cards.example: 非常感谢您的时间。 Thank you very much for your time.

cards.back: Bú kèqi. You're welcome.
cards.example: 不客气，这是小事。 You're welcome; it's a small thing.

cards.back: Duìbuqǐ. I'm sorry.
cards.example: 对不起，我来晚了。 Sorry, I'm late.

cards.back: Méi guānxi. It's okay; no problem.
cards.example: 没关系，请坐。 It's okay; please sit.

cards.back: Bù hǎoyìsi. Excuse me; sorry (for an inconvenience).
cards.example: 不好意思，请让一下。 Excuse me, please let me pass.

cards.back: Qǐngwèn. Excuse me, may I ask...?
cards.example: 请问，车站在哪儿？ Excuse me, where is the station?

cards.back: Qǐng jìn. Please come in.
cards.example: 门开着，请进。 The door is open; please come in.

cards.back: Qǐng zuò. Please sit down.
cards.example: 请坐，喝点茶吧。 Please sit; have some tea.

cards.back: Qǐng shāo děng. Please wait a moment.
cards.example: 请稍等，我马上回来。 Please wait a moment; I'll be right back.

cards.back: Méi wèntí. No problem.
cards.example: 没问题，我可以帮你。 No problem; I can help you.

cards.back: Hǎo de. Okay; all right.
cards.example: 好的，我知道了。 Okay, I understand.

cards.back: Nǐ hǎo ma? How are you?
cards.example: 好久不见，你好吗？ Long time no see; how are you?

cards.back: Wǒ hěn hǎo. I'm fine.
cards.example: 我很好，谢谢。 I'm fine, thank you.

cards.back: Nǐ ne? And you?
cards.example: 我喜欢茶，你呢？ I like tea; and you?

cards.back: Nǐ jiào shénme míngzi? What is your name?
cards.example: 你好，你叫什么名字？ Hello, what's your name?

cards.back: Wǒ jiào Lǐ Míng. My name is Li Ming.
cards.example: 我叫李明，很高兴认识你。 My name is Li Ming; nice to meet you.

cards.back: Hěn gāoxìng rènshi nǐ. Nice to meet you.
cards.example: 你好，很高兴认识你。 Hello; nice to meet you.

cards.back: Nǐ shì nǎ guó rén? What country are you from?
cards.example: 请问，你是哪国人？ May I ask what country you're from?

cards.back: Wǒ shì Měiguó rén. I'm American.
cards.example: 我是美国人，我住在北京。 I'm American; I live in Beijing.

cards.back: Nǐ zhù zài nǎr? Where do you live?
cards.example: 你住在哪儿，离这儿远吗？ Where do you live; is it far from here?

cards.back: Wǒ shì xuésheng. I'm a student.
cards.example: 我是学生，在这里学中文。 I'm a student studying Chinese here.

cards.back: Nǐ huì shuō Yīngyǔ ma? Can you speak English?
cards.example: 请问，你会说英语吗？ Excuse me, can you speak English?

cards.back: Wǒ huì shuō yìdiǎn Zhōngwén. I can speak a little Chinese.
cards.example: 我会说一点中文，还在学习。 I speak a little Chinese and am still learning.

cards.back: Wǒ tīng bu dǒng. I don't understand what I'm hearing.
cards.example: 对不起，我听不懂。 Sorry, I don't understand.

cards.back: Qǐng zài shuō yí biàn. Please say it again.
cards.example: 我没听清，请再说一遍。 I didn't hear clearly; please say it again.

cards.back: Qǐng shuō màn yìdiǎn. Please speak a little more slowly.
cards.example: 请说慢一点，我在学中文。 Please speak more slowly; I'm learning Chinese.

cards.back: Zhè shì shénme yìsi? What does this mean?
cards.example: 这个词，这是什么意思？ This word—what does it mean?

cards.back: Zhège yòng Zhōngwén zěnme shuō? How do you say this in Chinese?
cards.example: 请问，这个用中文怎么说？ Excuse me, how do you say this in Chinese?

cards.back: Qǐng xiě xiàlai. Please write it down.
cards.example: 这个地址，请写下来。 Please write down this address.

cards.back: Wǒ bù zhīdào. I don't know.
cards.example: 我不知道他在哪儿。 I don't know where he is.

cards.back: Wǒ míngbai le. I understand now.
cards.example: 谢谢，我明白了。 Thank you; I understand now.

cards.back: Duōshao qián? How much does it cost?
cards.example: 这本书多少钱？ How much is this book?

cards.back: Tài guì le. It's too expensive.
cards.example: 这件衣服太贵了。 This item of clothing is too expensive.

cards.back: Piányi yìdiǎn kěyǐ ma? Could it be a little cheaper?
cards.example: 我买两个，便宜一点可以吗？ I'll buy two; could it be a little cheaper?

cards.back: Wǒ yào zhège. I want this one.
cards.example: 我要这个，不要那个。 I want this one, not that one.

cards.back: Wǒ zhǐ shì kànkan. I'm just looking.
cards.example: 谢谢，我只是看看。 Thanks, I'm just looking.

cards.back: Kěyǐ shuā kǎ ma? Can I pay by card?
cards.example: 请问，可以刷卡吗？ Excuse me, can I pay by card?

cards.back: Kěyǐ yòng xiànjīn ma? Can I use cash?
cards.example: 这里可以用现金吗？ Can I use cash here?

cards.back: Yǒu dà yìdiǎn de ma? Do you have a larger one?
cards.example: 这件太小，有大一点的吗？ This is too small; do you have a larger one?

cards.back: Yǒu xiǎo yìdiǎn de ma? Do you have a smaller one?
cards.example: 这个太大，有小一点的吗？ This is too big; do you have a smaller one?

cards.back: Kěyǐ shì yíxià ma? May I try it?
cards.example: 这件外套可以试一下吗？ May I try this coat?

cards.back: Wǒ yào yì bēi shuǐ. I'd like a glass of water.
cards.example: 我要一杯水，谢谢。 I'd like a glass of water, thank you.

cards.back: Qǐng gěi wǒ càidān. Please give me the menu.
cards.example: 您好，请给我菜单。 Hello, please give me the menu.

cards.back: Nǐ tuījiàn shénme? What do you recommend?
cards.example: 我第一次来，你推荐什么？ It's my first visit; what do you recommend?

cards.back: Bú yào là. No spice, please.
cards.example: 这碗面不要辣。 No spice in this bowl of noodles, please.

cards.back: Wǒ chī sù. I'm vegetarian; I eat vegetarian food.
cards.example: 我吃素，有素菜吗？ I'm vegetarian; do you have vegetarian dishes?

cards.back: Wǒ duì huāshēng guòmǐn. I'm allergic to peanuts.
cards.example: 我对花生过敏，这里面有花生吗？ I'm allergic to peanuts; does this contain peanuts?

cards.back: Hěn hǎochī. It's delicious.
cards.example: 这道菜很好吃。 This dish is delicious.

cards.back: Wǒ chī bǎo le. I'm full.
cards.example: 谢谢，我吃饱了。 Thank you; I'm full.

cards.back: Qǐng mǎidān. The bill, please.
cards.example: 服务员，请买单。 Server, the bill, please.

cards.back: Kěyǐ dǎbāo ma? Can this be packed to go?
cards.example: 这些菜可以打包吗？ Can these dishes be packed to go?

cards.back: Xǐshǒujiān zài nǎr? Where is the restroom?
cards.example: 请问，洗手间在哪儿？ Excuse me, where is the restroom?

cards.back: Dìtiězhàn zài nǎr? Where is the subway station?
cards.example: 这附近的地铁站在哪儿？ Where is the nearby subway station?

cards.back: Zěnme qù jīchǎng? How do I get to the airport?
cards.example: 请问，怎么去机场？ Excuse me, how do I get to the airport?

cards.back: Wǎng zuǒ guǎi. Turn left.
cards.example: 到路口往左拐。 Turn left at the intersection.

cards.back: Wǎng yòu guǎi. Turn right.
cards.example: 前面往右拐。 Turn right up ahead.

cards.back: Yìzhí zǒu. Go straight ahead.
cards.example: 一直走就到了。 Go straight and you'll arrive.

cards.back: Lí zhèlǐ yuǎn ma? Is it far from here?
cards.example: 火车站离这里远吗？ Is the train station far from here?

cards.back: Wǒ mílù le. I'm lost.
cards.example: 我迷路了，请帮帮我。 I'm lost; please help me.

cards.back: Wǒ yào qù zhège dìzhǐ. I want to go to this address.
cards.example: 师傅，我要去这个地址。 Driver, I want to go to this address.

cards.back: Qǐng zài zhèlǐ tíng chē. Please stop the car here.
cards.example: 到了，请在这里停车。 We've arrived; please stop here.

cards.back: Xiànzài jǐ diǎn? What time is it now?
cards.example: 请问，现在几点？ Excuse me, what time is it?

cards.back: Jīntiān xīngqī jǐ? What day of the week is it today?
cards.example: 今天星期几，是星期二吗？ What day is it today; is it Tuesday?

cards.back: Shénme shíhou chūfā? When do we leave?
cards.example: 我们什么时候出发？ When do we leave?

cards.back: Wǒ yǒu yùdìng. I have a reservation.
cards.example: 你好，我有预订。 Hello, I have a reservation.

cards.back: Hái yǒu fángjiān ma? Are there still rooms available?
cards.example: 今晚还有房间吗？ Are there rooms available tonight?

cards.back: Wǒ yào zhù liǎng wǎn. I'd like to stay two nights.
cards.example: 我要住两晚，有房间吗？ I'd like to stay two nights; is a room available?

cards.back: Wúxiàn wǎngluò mìmǎ shì shénme? What is the Wi-Fi password?
cards.example: 请问，无线网络密码是什么？ Excuse me, what is the Wi-Fi password?

cards.back: Wǒ xūyào bāngzhù. I need help.
cards.example: 我需要帮助，请过来。 I need help; please come over.

cards.back: Qǐng bāng wǒ jiào jiùhùchē. Please call an ambulance for me.
cards.example: 有人受伤了，请帮我叫救护车。 Someone is hurt; please call an ambulance for me.

cards.back: Wǒ bù shūfu. I don't feel well.
cards.example: 我不舒服，想休息。 I don't feel well and want to rest.

cards.back: Wǒ tóu téng. I have a headache.
cards.example: 我头疼，想躺一会儿。 I have a headache and want to lie down a while.

cards.back: Yīyuàn zài nǎr? Where is the hospital?
cards.example: 最近的医院在哪儿？ Where is the nearest hospital?

cards.back: Wǒ de shǒujī diū le. My phone is lost.
cards.example: 我的手机丢了，你看见了吗？ My phone is lost; have you seen it?

cards.back: Xiǎoxīn. Be careful.
cards.example: 小心，地上有水。 Be careful; there's water on the floor.

cards.back: Jiùmìng! Help! (when in danger)
cards.example: 救命，有人落水了！ Help! Someone has fallen into the water!

cards.back: Jīntiān tiānqì hěn hǎo. The weather is nice today.
cards.example: 今天天气很好，我们去散步吧。 The weather is nice today; let's go for a walk.

cards.back: Xià yǔ le. It's raining; it has started to rain.
cards.example: 下雨了，带上伞吧。 It's raining; take an umbrella.

cards.back: Tài rè le. It's too hot.
cards.example: 今天太热了。 It's too hot today.

cards.back: Tài lěng le. It's too cold.
cards.example: 外面太冷了。 It's too cold outside.

cards.back: Wǒ è le. I'm hungry.
cards.example: 我饿了，我们吃饭吧。 I'm hungry; let's eat.

cards.back: Wǒ kě le. I'm thirsty.
cards.example: 我渴了，想喝水。 I'm thirsty and want water.

cards.back: Wǒ lèi le. I'm tired.
cards.example: 我累了，想休息。 I'm tired and want to rest.

cards.back: Yìqǐ qù ba. Let's go together.
cards.example: 你也去吗？一起去吧。 Are you going too? Let's go together.

cards.back: Nǐ yǒu kòng ma? Are you free?
cards.example: 明天你有空吗？ Are you free tomorrow?

cards.back: Wǒ méi kòng. I'm not free; I don't have time.
cards.example: 今天我没空。 I'm not free today.

cards.back: Děng yíxià. Wait a moment.
cards.example: 等一下，我拿包。 Wait a moment; I'll get my bag.

cards.back: Zhù nǐ shēngrì kuàilè. Happy birthday to you.
cards.example: 祝你生日快乐，天天开心。 Happy birthday; may you be happy every day.

cards.back: Xīnnián kuàilè. Happy New Year.
cards.example: 大家新年快乐。 Happy New Year, everyone.

cards.back: Zhù nǐ hǎo yùn. Good luck.
cards.example: 明天考试，祝你好运。 Good luck on tomorrow's exam.

cards.back: Yílù píng'ān. Have a safe journey.
cards.example: 明天出发吧？一路平安。 You leave tomorrow, right? Have a safe journey.
